The development-only C# recipes in ../reference/dictionary-property.cs independently execute the original Pascal property-assignment lowering against genuine Framework Dictionary, primitive/string operators and the source PABCSystem array/List concatenation/repetition algorithms. Regenerate with Windows PowerShell and ../reference/generate-dictionary-property.ps1. The original Pascal compiler is never invoked; no managed tools/runtime are shipped.

The source proof is TreeConverter/TreeConversion/syntax_tree_visitor.cs:16842–16843 and 17035–17058 (default property reference retains object/index expressions), then SyntaxTreeVisitorNodes/Assign.cs:422–433 and 492–495 (getter and setter both embed those expressions). Thus setter receiver/key are evaluated first, getter receiver/key second, getter value before the right-hand side, and setter last. The C# recipes explicitly call Set(Receiver(),Key(),Operation(Receiver()[Key()],Rhs())); the ordinary C# += operator would establish a different contract. List's existing native path already repeats its receiver/index and is retained.

dictionary-property-reference.tsv has 9984 outcomes: thirteen statically typed operation programs over integer, real, string, int[] and List<int> dictionary values; six receiver routes (including distinct/nil receivers), eight key routes (including differing/nil/missing keys), shared/distinct dictionaries, four right-hand-side behaviors, and normal/nil-or-zero initial values. RHS can redirect the receiver variable, clear a dictionary or mutate a previously read scalar/collection. Expected stdout includes each call in order and complete successful dictionary state/reference identities. Error cases preserve exact output before failure. Nil errors map to E_NIL and missing getter keys to E_KEY_NOT_FOUND.

The Pascal fixtures are generated from dictionary-property-program.pas.in with types fixed before compilation. Rows contain kind, operation, receiver route, key route, alias mode, RHS mode, seed, UTF-16 hex output (- means empty), and error code. The native test compiles thirteen independent typed programs and executes every row freshly. Runtime error text is checked in both languages; no expected rejection is turned into an implementation requirement.

dictionary-property-lambda-reference.tsv adds six actual delegate-equality outcomes for Dictionary, List and a scalar class property with captured/noncapturing callbacks. A single source lambda is evaluated twice, preserving its method identity and lexical captured cells. These tests catch reanalysing the same source expression into two different lambda methods; typed HIR copying preserves metadata while still repeating runtime effects.

The JSON records normalized source/fixture/corpus hashes. Additional checks cover changing keys/indices, static type rejection before output, record reads, work limits and the extracted portable package's exact bilingual nil-key error after RHS effects. This is selected compatibility evidence, not completion of Dictionary, PABCSystem, Collections, arbitrary source generics, record interfaces, object/exception support, or the bin/Lib port.
